name: Twenty CRM API
description: REST API for Twenty, an open-source CRM platform. Provides CRUD operations on CRM objects such as companies, people, opportunities, notes, tasks, and more. Uses cursor-based pagination, supports filtering with comparators, and ordering. The API schema is dynamically generated per workspace - this spec covers the core standard objects.
